reviewMode: source-only static code/domain review plus lightweight synthetic unit tests
verdict: no unresolved calculation defect in requested TRAIN text scope checks
verified: Visible reference and numerator include visible native and raster printing once on a physical line.
Native full and within-view source reference views are scored against method=native items filtered from merged analysis.evidence, not raw native extraction.
Known matching runs before unknown-mask containment; only unmatched fully contained evidence can be unassessed.
Polygon validation accepts at least three vertices; containment uses area intersection, not centroid or bounding envelope.
Source CropBox excludes only zero-overlap evidence; boundary-crossing evidence is retained for matching or insertion.
Nominal source membership completeness flags license outside-mask insertion assessment; scene hash/input geometry completeness alone do not.
Matching is geometric; reference text is used only for character error computation, not matching, repair, output filtering, or product changes.
Page-limited numerator and diagnostic counters now filter by evaluatedPages.

findings.summary: Native metricKind changed from native-extraction-fidelity to native-method-evidence-in-merged-analysis and scoper scope explicitly identifies the merged native method subset.
Excluded-page evidence contaminated unknown/outside counters. Scorer now filters by pageSet before assessment; new regression passes. S/D/I and CER were unaffected.

Generic per-metric scope string says printed scope even for native source-reference views containing invisible injected OCR. Correct metricKind and top-level rescore wording remove the operational ambiguity; source-domain wording would be more precise.

limitations: Review qualifies nominal source-domain diagnostics, not rendered glyph/ink accuracy.
Public exploratory records retain their original partial truth and do not gain independent full/within viewing-box domain views.
No browser, OCR, rendering, reserved/holdout payload, old sealed source, runtime edit, GT/domain edit, or rescore execution performed by this reviewer.
